config.label: RIGShare API key (Bearer format)
config.description: RIGShare API key (Bearer format). Required for the authenticated tools (booking, listing, session, quote, availability, cancel, extend, usage, and draft management). Without it, the public read-only tools (search, get equipment, list categories, owner onboarding) still work. Get a key at https://www.rigshare.app/profile#api-keys or contact support@rigshare.app.
